payload.name: Animacy Effect
payload.fact: Words associated with human and animal entities are better learned incidentally than words associated with vehicle entities.
payload.boundary: The effect is robust in children as young as 4 or 5 years and occurs with pictures as well as words.

provenance.title: A processing advantage in favor of animate entities in incidental word learning in young children.
provenance.quote_or_locus: the results showed that words associated with human and animal entities were better learned incidentally than words associated with vehicle entities

provenance.title: A processing advantage in favor of animate entities in incidental word learning in young children.
provenance.quote_or_locus: Overall, the results confirm the robustness of the animacy effect and show that this processing advantage can be found in an incidental learning task in children as young as 4 or 5 years
